model: FSKN120-BAC / FSKN24-BAC fire and smoke damper test module
equipment_type: Fire and smoke damper actuator test module
applies_to: Belimo FSKN120-BAC and FSKN24-BAC remote test modules for spring-return fire and combination fire/smoke damper actuators (FSTF, FSLF, FSNF, FSAFB, FSAF*A) in containment applications.
summary: The FSKN-BAC sits in the power feed of a fire or fire/smoke damper actuator and lets a BMS run a remote damper test. A test opens its relay so the damper springs closed, and the end switches are checked to prove the stroke; the result and the damper position are read over BACnet MS/TP (the same board also speaks Modbus RTU, chosen with DIP switch 6).
notes: State numbers are as printed; unused positions are shown as -.
Belimo warns the FSKN is not UL 864 UUKL listed and must not be used for any smoke control safety function.
Status flags (MI 106, MI 110, MI 111) latch until a Reset command is written to MV 120.
The same guide also covers Modbus RTU registers, which are not listed here.

source.title: FSKN120-BAC & FSKN24-BAC BACnet and Modbus protocol guide

integration.summary: Set DIP switch 6 ON for BACnet, set baud and MAC with the DIP switches, then write 3 (Test) to MV 120 to run a damper test. Read AI 1 position and BI 101 summary status for the result, and write 4 (Reset) to MV 120 to clear latched status.

minimum_points.name: Command
minimum_points.why: Write 3 = Test to stroke the damper, 4 = Reset

integration.enable: Writing 3 (Test) to MV 120 opens the module's relay so the damper springs closed; the position switches prove it. The value returns to None (1) by itself.
setup: DIP switches 1-2 set the baud rate (9600, 19200, 38400, 76800); a separate 8-switch address block sets the MAC address 0-127.
DIP switch 6 ON = BACnet, OFF = Modbus; DIP switch 5 ON enables the 150 ohm end-of-line termination.
Device instance = AV 121 OffsetDeviceID (default 1000) + MAC address.
gotchas: Not for smoke control safety functions; spring-return closed dampers only.
Status flags stay set until MV 120 = 4 (Reset).
Up to 64 active COV subscriptions, lifetime up to 8 hours.

points.name: RelPos
points.description: Damper position from the position switches (0, 50 or 100 %)

points.name: OffsetDeviceID
points.description: Device instance offset; instance = offset + MAC (default 1000)

points.name: Command
points.description: Start a damper test or reset status; returns to None
